Diffusé à une heure de grande écoute, le dimanche en début de soirée, ce magazine hebdomadaire d'une heure attire chaque semaine quelque 650 000 téléspectateurs, soit près de 20 pour cent de l'auditoire disponible à cette heure. L'émission couvre les faits médicaux, scientifiques et techniques de pointe, mais ses reportages ciblent en particulier les équipes de recherche canadiennes et québécoises et les problématiques qui ont un impact immédiat pour notre public.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris meets a labradoodle with a chronic sneezing problem. 2 year old Lulu suffers massive sneezing fits up to 4 times a day, and her devoted owner Kim is desperate for help. Chris fears Lulu may have a tumour.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris has been invited to Abu Dhabi after a special invitation to visit an extraordinary veterinary hospital. The hospital is for sick and injured falcons, and they are treated like royalty. Chris has to preform delicate surgery on a falcon wing.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A tiny kitten has been found abandoned in a cardboard box, and Chris is shocked at the extent of her injuries. She desperately needs surgery to try to repair her shattered leg. Then it's a heartwarming search to find her a new home.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: The finale to Chris's trip is an unforgettable encounter with some of China's precious Giant Pandas. Chris is granted the rare privilege of hand feeding some youngsters. He's then allowed into the most sacred area of all - the panda kindergarten to meet the adorable babies.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is confronted with an unusual patient, an albino echidna. But there's a question mark over whether the extremely rare echidna is a male or a female. It will have to be anaesthetised so Chris can investigate.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Tiny Amari has been born with a badly twisted back leg. At just 3 days old she's one of the youngest kittens Chris has ever seen at the clinic. The brave little battler needs a series of splints to try to save her leg, and give her a second chance.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris has travelled to the Cook Island to help out at a busy vet clinic in the capital Rarotonga. His first patient is Princess, a hit run victim. Chris quickly finds out just how tough it is looking after the local pets, with only basic facilities and limited supplies.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is spending 2 weeks volunteering at the busy Esther Honey vet clinic in the Cook Islands. This week his first patient is a much loved cat called Small One, which has part of its nose missing. Chris is immediately concerned that Small One may have a skin cancer.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris makes a special trip to Karara in Queensland to see Stubby, a tiny 3-week-old piglet, born with only one trotter. Stubby is struggling to get around. If the brave little battler is to survive, Chris needs to work out a way for her to walk normally.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris travels to Edgars Mission on the outskirts of Melbourne, where he is faced with a very woolly fugitive. Ben Hall is a sheep that was rescued after 5 years on the run, and Chris is shocked at the condition of his heavy coat. The thick, matted wool could be hiding all sorts of health problems.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is visiting remote Christmas Island where he has to help a seabird named Bill that is unable to fly. Bill is a rare Abbott’s Booby, and she's missing critical flight feathers. Chris needs to treat Bill's deformed wing, before starting rehabilitation with the young rescue bird.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Tim wants Chris to find out why Jack the koala has suddenly developed nasty bumps all over his face. Chris is so concerned, they take the little 2 year old to the local clinic for an immediate biopsy. When the results come back Tim is astonished to learn that Jack has acne.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A dairy buffalo called Penny has severely deformed horns, which are growing into her skull, dangerously close to her brain. Chris has to try to corral the timid 10 year old, and then carry out the painstaking job of carefully removing the horns.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is heading out to sea, to help try to save an endangered Grey Nurse shark, which has been spotted entangled in fishing line and with a hook stuck in its mouth. A specialist rescue team has been assembled and Chris is joining them in the water, to try to corral the injured shark so it can be brought to the surface.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is helping out at the Marlin Coast veterinary hospital in Cairns. His first patient is a young dog which has had a nasty encounter with a hedgecutter. Misty has ended up with deep cuts across her nose. How the young dog avoided more disastrous injuries is a miracle.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is helping out at the Marlin Coast veterinary hospital in Cairns, and his first patient is a rare Fijian iguana Called Ako. The Iguana hasn't been himself, and isn't eating properly. Chris needs to do an x-ray to try to work out what's going on. The results reveal a massive bladder stone inside the small animal, and he needs immediate surgery.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A little joey has been brought in to Chris at the Bondi clinic after its mother was hit and killed by a car. It's feared the frail orphan may have a broken leg, but carer Sandy is determined to give the little battler a chance. It's a huge challenge for Chris to try to repair the leg. It's a heart stopping moment when he finds if the risky surgery has been a success.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: On this episode of Bondi Vet a tense night in the ER as Chris fights to save a policeman’s pet which has been deliberately poisoned with snail bait . Add to that a mercy mission for a malnourished penguin washed up on Bondi beach and a scary operation for a seven month old pup whose leg is disintegrating.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: In Episode 2 of Bondi Vet, Chris confronts a bizarre and shocking act of cruelty as a 12 year old cat is deliberately dumped in the Bondi surf and left to die. There’s also a depressed parrot caught in a bizarre love triangle and can Lisa help a beautiful Samoyed survive a killer tick bite?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: This week stand by for a ground breaking operation at the Bondi clinic. Elroy, the out of control bulldog is being desexed and Chris is about to give him the very latest fake silicone testicles direct from the United States. Lisa hopes a blood transfusion can save a senior citizen and some very different patients including a sick owl spreading some nasty bugs and a turtle that’s wandered way off track.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: On this episode you will lose your heart to a brave golden retriever and her devoted owner.Rosie has severely deformed legs and only major surgery can save her life. How will owner Angus find the money and will the operation work? Chris also introduces us to one of Bondi’s most delightful dog loving eccentrics and a cutting edge solution for a record breaking goat.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: You will never forget Chris’ desperate fight to save the life of an innocent hit run victim. Lisa helps little Zoe battle a poisonous snake bite, we follow a lame lorikeet learning to fly again and the power of puppy school.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: In this episode a much loved Labrador in trouble after a head on collision with a car and Lisa is in a race against time to find the cause of a mystery illness that is threatening the life of a five month old kitten. As well, Chris heads to the bush and gets called out to help with a difficult birth.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: An unforgettable story as Chris takes home a fragile baby kangaroo with the odds against him….. will the joey make it without his mum? Plus a helping hand for a puppy with a life threatening problem. And Chris confronts his archenemy…a chihuahua with a mean streak.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: This week, follow Chris behind bars and meet three beautiful pups who are changing prisoners’ lives, a terrible ordeal for a pregnant beagle as Lisa struggles to save her life, a bunny that makes the Bondi vet cry and surfing lessons for Chris’ kelpie…Rusty.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: So ugly he’s cute! Meet sharpei puppy, Mr Wilson who is running the risk of going blind because of the massive folds of fat that hang over his eyes. Chris is hoping an eyelift will allow Mr Wilson to finally see the world.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris tackles a tricky rescue mission to try to save a mother and her three ducklings. The family have set up home in a disused swimming pool at a building site but the pool is full of rubbish and one duckling has already died. A new address is needed urgently but catching these submersive creatures is going to be very difficult.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: An eight month old kitten’s back legs have been shattered by a deliberate act of cruelty. Can Chris save eight month old Blackie?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Two peregrine falcons that live at the top of a high rise shopping centre mall in busy Bondi Junction have been struck down with a mystery illness. Can Chris find the answer and return the beautiful birds to their penthouse home.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris faces one of the most traumatic nights of his career when Bella the pug is rushed into the Bondi clinic. She is in labour and x rays show she’s carrying six huge puppies. During an emergency caesarean Chris and a team of vet nurses battle to save the babies and a critical Bella.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Two kooky cousins are worried their spoilt Pomeranian, Marie has swallowed some string from a bikini. Six month old Marie is vomiting and in pain and Chris has to try to diagnose the case while Hilary and Genevieve re decorate the clinic! Finally little Marie has to go to surgery and the girls are not coping. Watch for a whacky homecoming.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A mother duck has decided to hatch her nine babies on a high rise balcony. It’s a terrible choice. There’s no food, water or shelter from the sun and no way of getting out. Rounding them up is Chris’ first problem but their lives are in danger again when the release doesn’t go according to plan.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris heads to the bush this episode to try to sort out an intriguing call for help. Schnitzel is a sixteen month old daschund with a crazy obsession that’s putting his life in danger. Schnitzel won’t leave the new born calves alone and is in real danger of getting a kick to the head. The determined dog has already been trodden on and suffered a broken toe. Watch for farmer Scott’s scepticism about the vet’s left field solution. There’s also a mercy dash to help a calf with a fractured leg.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: An emergency night call for Chris as a little schnoodle (cross schnauzer and poodle) is rushed in after being run over by a taxi on a busy road. Distressed baby sitters, Brad and Thomas have been looking after Toby while his owners are holidaying in Queensland. The accident victim is traumatised and suffering from a punctured lung. Can Chris save Toby or will Brad and Thomas have to make a terrible phone call?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A case close to Lisa’s heart. Seven month old Danny nearly died from a paralysis tick bite when he was just a few weeks old. Now he’s back at Sash struggling to walk and breath. His doting owners think their precious golden retriever puppy has swallowed something but Lisa discovers Danny’s life is under threat once again.

programme.desc: After nearly losing her weapon while catching a dangerous criminal, Rita is taken off active duty to train at a facility in hand to hand combat for female police officers to avoid another dangerous situation. While there, she meets an old friend in the form of Robin Curry, a police officer with the Internal Affairs division of Palm Beach and the two catch up on old times. Robin seemed a little worried about something and tries to tell Rita during dinner but chooses not to. An hour or so later, Robin tries to call Rita up saying that she has to meet with her and so along with Chris, they go on the prowl to find her but are too late when Robin is found in a motel in her lingerie, cuffed and strangled to death. Things get personal for Rita at this point but her problems are just beginning when two officers from Special Investigations start asking sensitive questions about Rita's relationship with Robin, even suggesting that the two may have been lovers. Rita is shocked, appalled and extremely angry at the accusation and even more enraged when they suggest that Robin may have been crooked after $600,000 in evidence money turns up missing. Left high and dry and with no one else to turn to but Chris, Rita goes on a personal mission through the dark underworld of S&M in an attempt to fight for her rights as a cop and save the reputation of her deceased colleague who may have been murdered because Robin knew the truth behind who really stole the money...and who tried to set her and Rita up.

programme.desc: Explore Antarctica, one of the world's most beautiful, yet inhospitable, landscapes.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Nadie le cree al Abuelo Pitufo cuando habla de junglas y sabanas lejanas, repletas de gatos salvajes gigantes, caballos a rayas, comedores de hojas de cuello largo y extrañas tribus… Tan solo algunos Pitufitos dan cierto crédito a sus historias. Pero, cuando Abuelo Pitufo escucha en el bosque el sonido del tambor real mágico, un instrumento capaz de domar bestias salvajes, se lanza a la aventura para demostrar que no es un contador de historias al que el cerebro le juega malas pasadas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufina guía a los Pitufos de caminata por la naturaleza, pero Puppy se adelantó demasiado y tras perseguirlo acaban en el territorio de los Wartmongers. El Rey de los Wartmongers acaba haciéndoles prisioneros en burbujas, pero un grupo de rebeldes les rescata y consiguen huir a lomos de Puppy.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Qué, o quién, es ese extraño ser que hay en el bosque? Se asemeja vagamente a un Pitufo, pero castañetea los dientes como la ardilla que parece acompañarle… ¿y por qué habla Papá Pitufo acerca del Pitufito Perdido?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel ha ideado un nuevo y diabólico plan para librarse de los Pitufos: un polvo brillante que hará que no puedan dejar de reírse…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero es el encargado de arreglar todos los desperfectos en la Aldea Pitufa. Pero ¿valoran de verdad los demás Pitufos sus esfuerzos? De ningún modo. Al menos eso es lo que siente Pitufo Carpintero, quien decide abandonar la Aldea Pitufa para siempre e irse a vivir al mar con Marina, la sirena…

programme.title: El Genio De Granjero
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador se pregunta qué hace una calabaza en el melonar, cuando debería estar junto a los colinabos. Cuando Pitufo Labrador tira de la calabaza y la separa del suelo, libera a un genio que comienza a llamarle amo e insiste en concederle deseos. El ansia del genio, llamado Gourdy, por complacer a Pitufo Labrador hará que, más que en una ayuda, se convierta en una molestia.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Todos los Pitufos quieren un poema escrito para cada uno de ellos. Pitufo Poeta se siente superado por la presión y decide huir en busca de inspiración. El rey Fiera Bestia captura a Pitufo Poeta y lo obliga a escribir un poema para animar a su hija. Pitufo Poeta descubre que la motivación debe nacer del corazón, y nunca de la obligación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía ya no es bienvenido en el coro de los Pitufos: canta de una manera demasiado desafinada. Sin embargo, Papá Pitufo le entrega un amuleto que le convertirá en un virtuoso del canto. Y, por si fuera poco, aquí llega Hogata…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Creyendo que Bebé Pitufo es un duende, dos cazadores furtivos lo secuestran e intentan que el pequeño les diga dónde ha escondido la olla de oro. Papá Pitufo organiza a todos para atacar a los villanos con tartas de pitufrutas y lograr que Bebé Pitufo pueda escapar.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Ninguno de los Pitufos parece tener tiempo para jugar con los Pitufitos. Deciden visitar a Padre Tiempo y llegan al Río del Tiempo, la inmensa corriente que fluye majestuosamente, transportando todo el tiempo del mundo. Entonces, se produce un accidente que tendrá inoportunas consecuencias…

programme.title: La Aguja Mágica De Pitufo Sastre
programme.desc: Pitufo Sastre tiene que crear un conjunto para cada Pitufo antes del desfile de moda de otoño. Pitufo Filósofo quiere ayudarle y, usando el libro de magia de Papá Pitufo, conjura una aguja mágica que cose diez veces más rápido que un sastre… ¿Pero es eso algo realmente bueno?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Selwyn y Tallulah son un matrimonio de poderosos hechiceros. El problema es que están todo el rato peleándose. La energía de sus discusiones está formando una temible tormenta, y Papá Pitufo debe conseguir que hagan las paces antes de que la tormenta arrecie.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Baltasar lleva a Denisa con Gargamel para que este haga de canguro. Sin embargo, Gargamel pierde a Denisa en el bosque y esta se encuentra con Sasita y se hace amiga de ella. Sasita y Denisa colaboran para sacar a los Pitufos del caldero de Gargamel y demostrar que la valentía no es cuestión de tamaño.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Guillermo, el bufón de la corte, es el amigo humano de los Pitufos. Va a haber un festejo en el castillo del rey y Guillermo invita amablemente a sus pequeños amigos azules al banquete. Sin embargo, descubren que el malévolo chambelán está afanando las posesiones del rey.

programme.title: El Amigo Más Pitufo
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo tenía un amigo: Pitufo Torpe. Pero el pobre Pitufo Torpe es tan… bueno, torpe, que Pitufo Filósofo no quiere volverle a ver. Así que ahora no queda nadie dispuesto a escucharle. Quizá Buddy, el apuesto diablillo que ha conocido por casualidad cerca del gran roble, pueda convertirse en amigo de Pitufo Filósofo…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Una de las cosas con las que más disfruta Abuelo Pitufo es contar una buena historia de miedo, y a la mayoría de los Pitufos les encantan. Sin embargo, las cosas se complican para Pitufo Filósofo cuando Abuelo Pitufo habla de las pitufiánimas y estas comienzan a acecharle…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Goloso Y La Olla De Estofado
programme.desc: El hada buena Guinilda entrega a Pitufo Goloso una olla mágica, pero Pitufo Filósofo hace que se desborde e inunde la aldea y el bosque. La bienintencionada hada acude al rescate y pide que le devuelvan la olla para dársela a un orfanato de niños hambrientos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Para demostrar lo válido que es su «Gran libro de supervivencia en la naturaleza», Pitufo Filósofo se lleva a los Pitufitos al pantano. Allí, gracias a su experto consejo, el pequeño grupo se extravía, queda atrapado en arenas movedizas y es capturado por el Rey Verrugoso. Afortunadamente, el Rey Verrugoso está con ganas de jugar y decide hacer una caza del Pitufo. Desafortunadamente, Pitufo Filósofo cree que es un líder por naturaleza…

programme.title: La Carrera De Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero ha ideado un nuevo invento: el pitufimóvil. Todos los Pitufos tienen su propio vehículo personalizado y todos (o casi todos) disfrutan dando una vuelta en ellos. Sin embargo, el malvado mago Gargamel se aprovecha de la idea y empieza a causar problemas a los Pitufos…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado primo del Rey, Malcolm, lo ha convertido en un ciervo negro para poder acabar con él y ponerle en su sala de trofeos. Los Pitufos irán a ayudar a su amigo y, tras devolver al Rey a su verdadera forma, Malcom acabará preso dentro del cuerpo del ciervo negro.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En la antigua India, el pérfido faquir Gargapuri vende a los Pitufos al rajá para su zoo privado. Únicamente Abuelo Pitufo, Pitufo Salvaje y Pitufo Bromista quedan libres, así que tendrán que entrar a hurtadillas en el palacio para rescatar a sus amigos. Por el camino, liberan a todos los animales enjaulados de la colección del rajá.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Epidemia De La Tos Saltarina
programme.desc: Gargamel propaga un extraño germen por el bosque que hace toser a todos sin parar. Bebé Pitufo es la primera víctima y todo el pueblo está muy preocupado…Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo cree conocer la solución.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel inventa la leyenda del Pitufo Hechicero para engañar a Papá Pitufo y sus amigos Pitufos y conducirlos hacia una trampa en lo alto de la montaña. Papá Pitufo, con su ingenio, engaña al mago con algo de sus propia magia y Gargamel es perseguido montaña abajo y devuelto de nuevo a su castillo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: El Pitufo Que Queria Ser Rey
programme.desc: Pitufo Soñador anhela convertirse en rey después de leer una historia sobre reyes. Mientras está en su barco, cae a través de un remolino y llega a una tierra de pequeños seres que creen que Pitufo Soñador es su rey, desaparecido hace mucho tiempo. Cuando se enfrenta a los Norfnangs, los enemigos de esos pequeños seres, descubre que no son terroríficos en absoluto. Pitufo Soñador se da un golpe en la cabeza y descubre al despertar que todo había sido un sueño, aunque encuentra en su gorro una joya idéntica a las que extraían esos pequeños seres de su mina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El Día de los Inocentes Pitufo resulta no ser tan divertido cuando Gargamel se pone un disfraz de Pitufoarbusto para capturar al pequeño Pitufo Feliz. Papá Pitufo pide ayuda a Pitufopluma para que llame a los pájaros y ataquen al falso arbusto.

programme.title: La Belleza Es Superficial
programme.desc: Periwinkle, un hada vanidosa, se molesta cuando su espejo mágico le dice que el ser más hermoso es Pitufo Vanidoso, y no ella. Periwinkle secuestra a Pitufo Vanidoso, pero los demás Pitufos acuden al rescate. Periwinkle se da cuenta de que ha obrado mal y se convierten en amigos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Tontín y Pitufina son capturados para ser exhibidos en una Feria. Papá Pitufo aprovecha la torpeza de Gargamel para rescatarlos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando Pitufina se encuentra con una amable y anciana gitana en el bosque y esta le regala un vestido multicolor con vuelo, se muestra encantada. ¿Quién hubiera imaginado que, en realidad, esa mujer era el malvado mago Gargamel disfrazado y que el hermoso vestido oculta un terrible hechizo?

programme.title: La Carrera De Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero ha ideado un nuevo invento: el pitufimóvil. Todos los Pitufos tienen su propio vehículo personalizado y todos (o casi todos) disfrutan dando una vuelta en ellos. Sin embargo, el malvado mago Gargamel se aprovecha de la idea y empieza a causar problemas a los Pitufos…

programme.title: El Amo Escrúpulo
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador es el reticente amo de un genio llamado Gourdy, cuyo entusiasmo por ser servicial es quizá algo excesivo. Tras un nuevo incidente provocado por el exceso de celo de Gourdy, Pitufo Labrador le dice algo que no debería haber dicho y Gourdy desaparece. ¿Y a que no adivinas quién lo encuentra? En efecto: Escrupuloso, el aprendiz del malvado mago Gargamel. ¿Y quién podría arrebatar a Gourdy de las manos de Escrupuloso, sino el propio Gargamel?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La jungla de Sudamérica no es precisamente el lugar en el que Pitufo Vanidoso querría pasar el resto de sus días. Además, empieza a bailar como un poseso cuando contrae la fiebre tropical. Su danza tendrá extrañas consecuencias.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel infecta de odio el corazón de Pitufo Fortachón y, a continuación, usa al pequeño Pitufo como señuelo para los demás. Afortunadamente, el amor de Pitufo Fortachón vence al odio y ayuda a sus pequeños amigos a escapar de las garras de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos se encuentran en una paradisíaca isla del Pacífico. Bueno, no exactamente paradisíaca, ya que hay un volcán muy activo en el que Pitufo Fortachón, también muy activo, arriesga tanto su vida como la de Pitufina.

programme.title: El Color Mas Pitufoso
programme.desc: Spectra es el hada de los colores, y con su rueda de los colores crea todos los azules, rojos, amarillos y verdes del mundo. Es amiga de Pitufo Pintor, pero, cuando este lleva a los Pitufitos a su morada en su ausencia, los Pitufitos se ponen a jugar con la rueda de los colores… y provocan que todos los colores desaparezcan de la Tierra. Y, lo que es aún peor: sin colores, el hada de los colores no puede vivir…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un duende maligno le pone unos zapatos mágicos a Pitufina, que no puede dejar de bailar, con la intención de que le prometa que se casará con él. Todos sus pequeños amigos acuden a rescatarla y Papá Pitufo consigue ponerle los zapatos mágicos al duende, obligándole a bailar hasta que se hace de noche.

programme.title: El Pitufo Galante
programme.desc: La reina Agripina no dejará que su hijo, el príncipe Godofredo, se case con la dulce Priscila. Ella quiere como nuera a una chica que sea capaz de mostrarle algo que nunca antes haya visto. Cuando Hogata se entera y descubre la existencia de Abuelo Pitufo, está segura de que logrará sorprender a la reina con su captura. Por supuesto, Hogata debe atrapar primero a Abuelo Pitufo…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Celoso por la atención que recibe Pitufo Vanidoso cuando se rompe un dedo del pie, Pitufo Bromista finge estar enfermo con la esperanza de que le hagan caso. Desafortunadamente, su treta se vuelve en su contra y, en lugar de amorosos cuidados, todo lo que recibe es un proverbial merecido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cada vez que Pitufo Perezoso se queda dormido, tiene la misma pesadilla una y otra vez: se encuentra en poder de Morfeo, un malvado hechicero que quiere capturar a tantas almas dormidas como sea posible. Uno tras otro, todos los Pitufos van cayendo en las garras de Morfeo. ¿Todos? Quizá no, si Papá Pitufo puede evitarlo. Para ello, Papá Pitufo acude al Arenero en busca de ayuda…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La primavera provoca que todos los Pitufos estén compitiendo por el amor de Pitufina y Gargamel decide hechizarla para que le ayuda a capturarlos. Papá Pitufo toma cartas en el asunto y con la ayuda del despistado gato Azrael consigue darle la vuelta al plan.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Epidemia De La Tos Saltarina
programme.desc: Gargamel propaga un extraño germen por el bosque que hace toser a todos sin parar. Bebé Pitufo es la primera víctima y todo el pueblo está muy preocupado…Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo cree conocer la solución.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En la Aldea Pitufo hay un ataque de Mala Suerte y cien Pitufos deben bailar una danza mágica para recuperar la buena fortuna, ¡pero sólo hay 99 en la aldea! ¿Quién será el centésimo Pitufo?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos intentan evitar el contacto con los humanos. Esta vez, sin embargo, Sasita se ha hecho amiga de una pequeña bruja llamada Melina, cuyos hechizos suelen acabar en desastre. De todas formas, ¿son las brujas realmente humanas? En cualquier caso, los brujos como Gargamel sí que lo son.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos serían un delicioso manjar para el malvado mago Gargamel si no fuera por dos cosas: son difíciles de atrapar y también muy pequeños. Ahora bien, si hubiera una fórmula que permitiera transformar a esos pequeños aperitivos de bocado en grandes y jugosas raciones azules… Gargamel ha tenido una idea…

programme.title: Pituplicación
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel crea una fórmula mágica que duplica todo aquello que toca. Y…¡sorpresa! ¡Ahora hay seis Pitufos Filósofos! Esto provoca algunas situaciones interesantes en la aldea… ¡Y también en casa de Gargamel!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Todos los Pitufos quieren un poema escrito para cada uno de ellos. Pitufo Poeta se siente superado por la presión y decide huir en busca de inspiración. El rey Fiera Bestia captura a Pitufo Poeta y lo obliga a escribir un poema para animar a su hija. Pitufo Poeta descubre que la motivación debe nacer del corazón, y nunca de la obligación.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En la antigua India, el pérfido faquir Gargapuri vende a los Pitufos al rajá para su zoo privado. Únicamente Abuelo Pitufo, Pitufo Salvaje y Pitufo Bromista quedan libres, así que tendrán que entrar a hurtadillas en el palacio para rescatar a sus amigos. Por el camino, liberan a todos los animales enjaulados de la colección del rajá.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Soñador verá cumplido su deseo de ser un Astropitufo cuando Papá Pitufo le hechiza para quedarse dormido, transformando el paisaje y a los Pitufos en una fantasía galáctica. Gargamel vigila de cerca las travesuras de los Pitufos desde su bola de cristal, pero el hechizo de Papá Pitufo también tiene efecto en él y le transporta hasta el centro de una tormenta.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Es la primera Navidad de Pitufo Salvaje y está impresionado por la decoración de la Aldea Pitufa. Pero Abuelo Pitufo y Sasita van a enseñarle el auténtico significado de la Navidad cuando ayudan a una pareja de ancianos a disfrutar de la Navidad más hermosa que jamás hayan vivido…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La vida en la Aldea Pitufa podría ser más tranquila si Puppy se comportara un poco mejor. Sin embargo, el pequeño perro de los Pitufos se dedica a escarbar entre las flores de Pitufina, ensuciar el nuevo papel pintado de Pitufo Vanidoso y arruinar los experimentos de Papá Pitufo. Aun así, Puppy va a ayudar a los Pitufos a escapar de una trampa que les ha tendido Gargamel. O quizá no tenga la disciplina necesaria para ello…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿A dónde se han ido todas las ardillas? Pitufo Salvaje está algo preocupado. Y estaría aún más preocupado si supiera el malvado plan que ha tramado la horrible bruja Hogata para preparar un tónico capilar.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía ya no es bienvenido en el coro de los Pitufos: canta de una manera demasiado desafinada. Sin embargo, Papá Pitufo le entrega un amuleto que le convertirá en un virtuoso del canto. Y, por si fuera poco, aquí llega Hogata…

programme.title: La Pitufo Sinfonía
programme.desc: Pitufo Armonía tiene prohibido tocar en la Aldea Pitufo y Gargamel aprovecha para engañarlo e intentar capturar Pitufos con un hechizo musical.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Epidemia De La Tos Saltarina
programme.desc: Gargamel propaga un extraño germen por el bosque que hace toser a todos sin parar. Bebé Pitufo es la primera víctima y todo el pueblo está muy preocupado…Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo cree conocer la solución.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Primera Palabra De Bebe Pitufo
programme.desc: Los Pitufitos liberan a los Pitufos de las garras de Gargamel justo a tiempo para llevar a Bebé Pitufo a la ceremonia de su primera palabra. Bebé Pitufo pronuncia la palabra «Gargamel». Papá Pitufo afirma que esa palabra indica que Bebé Pitufo se convertirá un día en un gran líder, ya que significa que es consciente de los peligros de la vida.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Simón se ha perdido en el bosque buscando a sus padres, una pareja de gigantes. Los Pitufos tratarán de llevarlo de vuelta a su casa, pero gargamel aparecerá una vez más con no muy buenas intenciones.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Cama Voladora De Papa Pitufo
programme.desc: Gargamel lanza un hechizo a la nueva cama de Papá Pitufo para que cualquiera que duerma en ella sea transportado al lugar con el que esté soñando. Los ensueños de los Pitufos les llevan a un barco, un castillo y, por último, hasta Gargamel. Consiguen escapar cuando Pitufo Torpe se queda dormido y sueña con su hogar.

programme.title: Pitufo En Rascacielos
programme.desc: Está claro que una aldea de casas con forma de seta es bonita y alegre… Sin embargo, no resulta muy moderna a los ojos de Pitufo Arquitecto. Lo que los Pitufos necesitan es un rascacielos, un nuevo y atrevido concepto que cambiará su forma de vivir para siempre…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo y Bebé Pitufo mezclan las fórmulas de Papá Pitufo con consecuencias desastrosas, dejándoles a merced de un ejército de hambrientas langostas que Gargamel ha soltado en el bosque.

programme.title: Llamen Al Doctor Pitufo
programme.desc: Tal como su propio nombre indica, Pitufo Aficionado es incapaz de concentrarse en una actividad concreta. Pasa de una cosa a otra con tremenda facilidad y nunca termina lo que empieza. Pero, de repente, descubre que le apasiona la profesión médica. Pitufo Aficionado quiere convertirse en doctor y todos los Pitufos, con Papá Pitufo a la cabeza, van a ayudarle a cumplir su deseo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel vuelve a estar en problemas. Si no puede reunir una enorme cantidad de oro para el atardecer, le arrebatarán todas sus posesiones. Sin embargo, los Pitufos van a ayudar a su archienemigo… hasta cierto punto.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Si hay algo que la malvada hechicera Clorhidris no puede soportar es la felicidad de las demás personas. Contemplar la vida de los Pitufos, llena de amabilidad y canciones, pone furiosa a Clorhidris. Debe destruir esas risas y ahogar esas felices conversaciones… Entonces, planta la raíz del mal en el bosque y, poco después, todos los Pitufos dejan de hablarse. El único que no se ha visto afectado es Bebé Pitufo…

programme.title: El Castillo De Las Disputas
programme.desc: En el Castillo de las Disputas casi nunca se escuchan palabras amables. El brujo Selwyn y su pareja, la bruja Tallulah, se pasan el tiempo discutiendo. Tharp, la gárgola que tienen como mascota, se refugia en la Aldea Pitufa. Pero algo terrible va a suceder…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Genio inventa una máquina que hará todo el trabajo de cosechar y preparar la comido de los Pitufos. Pero esta milagrosa invención tiene sus bemoles.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Robotín se siente tan solo que, compadeciéndose de él, Pitufo Carpintero le construye una compañera. El problema es que PituforRobotínina no sabe que únicamente debe fijarse en su compañero mecánico, o que debe evitar a Gargamel…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Primera Navidad De Bebe Pitufo
programme.desc: La ilusión de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolás para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo y los demás pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Escrupulo Y El Libro De Los Hechizos
programme.desc: Cuando Escrupuloso, el ayudante del malvado Gargamel, encuentra el Gran libro de hechizos en el sótano de su maestro, le pide poder para convertirse en el mago más poderoso del mundo. Y esto supondrá problemas para los pobres Pitufos…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo le da a Pitufo Debilucho una crema especial para que la utilice y recupere su fuerza. Poco después, recibe una condecoración por sus heroicos actos de fortaleza, y su autoestima se dispara cuando se da cuenta de que la crema es simplemente mermelada de pitufrutas.

programme.title: El Capricho De Travieso
programme.desc: ¿Sabías que, si atrapas un trol, este puede concederte un deseo? Resulta que Aloysius el trol ha quedado atrapado en una de las pitufitrampas de Gargamel. Pitufo Colérico le libera y, como recompensa, consigue que los demás Pitufos satisfagan todos sus caprichos. Esto acarrea un montón de problemas para los Pitufos, ya que los Pitufitos, en ocasiones, piden cosas que no son buenas para ellos… ni tampoco para los demás.

programme.title: Don Pituzorro
programme.desc: Todo el mundo tiene sus propios sueños. El de Pitufina es conocer al legendario Don Pituzorro, el gallardo, ingenioso e intrépido héroe de numerosas y cautivadoras aventuras. Los Pitufos no toman en serio ese encaprichamiento. Sin embargo, cuando un Don Pituzorro real aparece en la aldea y Pitufina les ignora en favor del jactancioso extraño, se toman el asunto algo más en serio.

programme.title: Sorpresa Para Sassette
programme.desc: A veces, los pequeños actos pueden tener grandes consecuencias. Mientras intentaba atrapar a Sasita, Gargamel altera la Balanza de la Verdad y, desde ese momento, todos los habitantes del mundo comienzan a mentir. Incluso Papá Pitufo se ha convertido en un mentiroso compulsivo. Y, por si eso fuera poco, el espíritu de la balanza ha encadenado juntos a Gargamel y Sasita, que deberán volver a colocar en su sitio el Topacio de la Verdad…

programme.title: Pitufos Helados
programme.desc: El invierno ha llegado y los Pitufos están a punto de sucumbir al intenso frío. ¿Podrá Pitufo Rastreador encontrar el remedio sin caer en las garras de Gargamel?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuidar de los animales produce consecuencias inesperadas cuando los Pitufos deciden llevar a un bebé dinosaurio de vuelta a casa… ¡a su propia era! Este es el inicio de una serie de aventuras en las que recorrerán el espacio y el tiempo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras intenta escabullirse de sus tareas, Pitufo Perezoso encuentra un antiguo pozo abandonado con una interesante peculiaridad: cualquier objeto que uno baje en el cubo regresa como nuevo. Pero ¿es eso bueno?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos llevan a Abuelo Pitufo al castillo del rey para que pueda conocer a Guillermo. Pero, entre una cosa y otra (sobre todo otra), los Pitufos y Guillermo acaban a bordo de una gran nave vikinga. Los vikingos creen que Guillermo es su mítico gran guerrero, aquel que derrotará al Rey Tormenta. ¿Podrán los Pitufos ayudar a Guillermo a salir de este embrollo?

programme.title: Pitufos Y Solo Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel ha conseguido capturar a Pitufina. Ahora, se dispone a administrarle un suero de la verdad para descubrir todos los secretos de Papá Pitufo… pero Gargamel comete un gran error y le da a Pitufina una fórmula de las mentiras.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Abuelo Pitufo llevaba algunos cientos de años sin ver su antiguo juguete. Se lo entregaron a Papá Pitufo hace mucho tiempo y no recuerda exactamente cómo funciona. ¡Pero Bebé Pitufo sabe que tiene sorpresas para todos!

programme.title: Aquel Que Pitufa El Último…
programme.desc: Pitufo Bromista se pasa de la raya con sus bromas cuando Clorhidris cae víctima de una de ellas. Para vengarse de los Pitufos, crea un hechizo para robar su sentido del humor. Pitufo Gruñón, que ya de por sí no tenía sentido del humor, se hace con la poción de humor y rompe el hechizo.

programme.title: Medicina Para Bromista
programme.desc: Por culpa de todas las bromas que gasta Pitufo Bromista, ningún Pitufo le cree cuando les avisa de que el gato Azrael está a punto de atacarlos. Como se siente culpable, se dirige al castillo de Gargamel y le gasta unas cuantas bromas muy explosivas al mago y a su gato para poder liberar a sus amigos.

programme.desc: Actress Emma Hutton is determined to help find her friend Hope a perfect match but in doing so, she accidentally tramples on several hearts. When Emma realizes she herself has always loved her good friend Gray, Emma learns love works best when she doesn’t meddle with it. A charming romance inspired by Jane Austen’s "Emma."

programme.title: Love Finds You In Valentine
programme.desc: What can a California girl do with a few dusty acres of land in rural Nebraska? So Kennedy Blaine wonders after she inherits a ranch in the small town of Valentine, Nebraska. As Kennedy makes arrangements to sell the property, she finds herself drawn to the ranch and to its attractive manager, Derek Sterling. She decides to spend the summer in her ancestral home and reconnect with family members. But soon Kennedy is subjected to harassment by someone who clearly wants her to leave Valentine. Depending on God’s protection and Derek’s assistance, she sets out to discover who is behind the offenses. But when her search reveals painful details about her family and raises questions about Derek’s own past, will Kennedy still want to know the truth?

programme.title: Love In Aruba
programme.desc: A lonely teacher (Amber) is hired by Connor, the single father of a struggling student. She is to tutor his daughter Macey (age 10) over a summer while they travel for his work. As Amber helps Macey, she sees glimpses of what’s missing in the family’s life. Their grand destinations are filled with rich items and potential rewarding business deals, but it’s missing heart. Amber’s influence fills the void and brings Macey and Connor together. With it, Amber starts to fall in love with Connor, but can he see her as anything beyond the hired help?

When her parents insist on meeting the man, Sarah hires Bob, an actor, to pretend to be her "beau". The masquerade works flawlessly for a time and brings comic situations, but in the end, their lives are irrevocably changed.

They juggle their work traveling around the world while seeing each other again. Both know there’s something special between them, but it will be put to the test when Kade’s competitive boss challenges Kade to thwart Nicole’s business.

programme.title: Hope Is Here

programme.desc: HOPE IS HERE features inspiring and uplifting, relevant and refreshing, personal stories told by cancer survivors, their families, and the loved ones of those who lost the fight against this “emperor of all maladies” and sparked a movement that gives added meaning to their lives. Their moving stories show how the light of hope is salvaged from depths of despair.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.sub-title: Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E2
programme.desc: Lung cancer diagnoses for young, non-smoking individuals are a growing trend. But that didn't intimidate the athletic and courageous lung cancer patient, 21-year-old Jill Costello. Jill's fighting spirit and her desire to help find a cure and eradicate the stigma that only smokers contracted the disease would eventually define her legacy.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.sub-title: Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E3
programme.desc: Hank Baskett was given the grim diagnosis of stage 4 lung cancer almost ten years ago. At the time his thoughts were not of himself but of how he was going to tell his family. In episode 3 of Hope is Here we meet Hank and his family and learn how he was able to push forward towards health with a hopeful attitude and mission that his cancer journey would be, in his words, a joyful one.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.sub-title: Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E4
programme.desc: Gina Hollenbeck is positive about life. Every day she lives with an optimistic desire to overcome and thrive despite a stage 4 lung cancer diagnosis. As a young mother of two boys, she forges ahead towards a vibrant and meaningful journey with a mission to help find a cure for not only herself but for others who suffer from this deadly disease.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.sub-title: Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E5
programme.desc: Emily Bennett Taylor and her husband Miles were newlyweds with a bright future planned. Just as they were house hunting and talking about raising a family Emily received the news that she had stage 4 lung cancer. She and her husband recall their cancer journey and recount their determination to live life to its fullest while fighting for the chance to have children despite a grave cancer diagnosis.

programme.title: Hope Is Here
programme.sub-title: Health Day - Hope Is Here S1E6
programme.desc: Life can be full of hope and dreams. Lisa Briggs was enjoying a successful business, and a close-knit family while celebrating the arrival of her second child. Yet within months of giving birth Lisa was told the devastating news; she had stage 4 lung cancer. For an athletic, young woman who never smoked, the diagnosis seemed unreal. After the shock wore off, Lisa went into full action ahead as her will to live proved stronger than her devastating cancer.

programme.title: Männer des Gesetzes
programme.desc: Texas, 1890. Staub wirbelt über die Schienen, als Marshal Howard Nightingale mit einem Zug voller Deputies und Fotografen durchs Land rollt. Sein Ziel: Ruhm, Macht – und der gefährlichste Bandit des Westens. Jack Strawhorn, Bankräuber und Gesetzloser, ist der Schlüssel zu Nightingales politischem Traum. Die Jagd beginnt mit Donnerhall und Pulverdampf, ein gnadenloser Ritt durch staubige Städte und endlose Ebenen. Doch im Westen ist nichts, wie es scheint. Als Nightingale den Outlaw endlich stellt, dreht sich das Spiel: Strawhorn schlägt zurück, nimmt den Marshal gefangen und stellt ihn vor die Augen der Männer bloß, die einst für ihn kämpften. Loyalität zerbricht, Colts sprechen lauter als Worte. In einem Land, wo Ruhm schneller stirbt als ein Sonnenuntergang, entscheidet sich, wer wirklich das Gesetz in Händen hält – und wer nur ein Narr im Schatten der Macht ist.

programme.title: Vier Fäuste schlagen wieder zu
programme.desc: Zwei sorglose Herumtreiber geraten in ein chaotisches Abenteuer, nachdem sie versehentlich eine lokale Bande verärgert haben.

programme.title: Ein Tag zum Kämpfen
programme.desc: Eine dramatisierte Darstellung von General Custers Aufstieg und Fall, die in der Schlacht am Little Bighorn gipfelt.

programme.title: Abilene Town - Banditen ohne Maske
programme.desc: Ein Sheriff an der Grenze kämpft darum, zwischen Siedlern und Viehzüchtern Frieden zu bewahren, während die Stadt gespalten ist.

programme.title: Rhapsodie in Blei
programme.desc: Der Wilde Westen spielt verrückt, als der größte Schnellziehende, elegant gekleidete, silbersporntragende, Gitarrenspielende und singende Cowboy-Matinee-Star Rex O’Herlihan (Tom Berenger) in den Sattel steigt – in dieser schrägen, liebevollen Persiflage auf die B-Western der 1940er-Jahre. Rex kennt alle Regeln des Genres: Der Viehbaron ist böse, die Schafzüchter sind arm, und irgendwo wartet eine Frau, die ihn anhimmelt. Mit blitzschnellem Colt und einem Lächeln, das selbst Kugeln alt aussehen lässt, reitet er in eine Stadt voller Klischees. Dort trifft er auf den skrupellosen Colonel Ticonderoga, der die Eisenbahn als Waffe benutzt, und auf eine schöne Rancherin, die für Herzklopfen sorgt. Doch die Parodie wird zum Abenteuer, als der Colonel einen singenden Revolverhelden schickt – Bob Barber. Zwischen übertriebenen Duellen, Saloon-Gesängen und selbstironischen Kommentaren liefert Berenger eine Hommage an das Genre, die Humor und Action perfekt mischt. Ein Western, der alle Regeln kennt – und sie genüsslich bricht.

programme.title: Der Galgenstrick
programme.desc: Henry Moon, ein charmanter Gauner mit mehr Glück als Verstand, steht kurz vor dem Galgen – bis ihn die eigensinnige Julia Tate rettet. Aber nicht aus Liebe: Sie braucht einen Ehemann, um ihr Land behalten zu dürfen. Moon sagt „Ja“ – in der Hoffnung auf ein bequemes Leben. Doch Julia hat andere Pläne: Schaufel in die Hand und ran an die Mine! Was folgt, ist ein wilder Ritt durch Missverständnisse, Dynamit, und eine Ehe, die mehr nach Duell als nach Zweisamkeit aussieht. Während Moon versucht, sich aus der Arbeit rauszulügen, tauchen alte Kumpanen auf, die glauben, er sei reich. Julia hingegen entdeckt, dass unter Moons Dreckschicht vielleicht doch ein Herz schlägt. Zwischen Goldrausch, Gesetzeshütern und Gefühlschaos wird klar: Manchmal ist der Galgenstrick der Anfang einer großen Liebe – oder zumindest einer sehr unterhaltsamen Katastrophe.

programme.title: In schlechter Gesellschaft
programme.desc: 1863. Bürgerkrieg. Staubige Straßen, brennende Horizonte. Drew Dixon flieht vor der Armee und stolpert in die Arme von Jake Rumsey – ein Teufelskerl mit einem Colt und einem Lächeln, das töten kann. Gemeinsam mit einer Bande Halbstarker ziehen sie los: Pferde stehlen, Züge überfallen, Schüsse im Morgengrauen. Doch der Westen ist gnadenlos. Big Joe, ein Outlaw mit Augen wie Stahl, jagt sie wie Wölfe. Kugeln pfeifen, Blut färbt den Boden. Freundschaft wird zur Waffe, Vertrauen zur Lüge. Als Rumsey am Galgen hängt, reitet Drew durch Feuer und Rauch, um ihn zu retten. Aber der Westen kennt keine Helden – nur Männer, die schneller ziehen als ihr Schatten. Am Ende kracht Dynamit, Colts glühen, und zwei verlorene Seelen reiten in die Hölle, während die Sonne untergeht und der Wind den letzten Schrei davonträgt.

programme.title: Mörder des Klans
programme.desc: Nach einem Raubzug trifft sich die Hogan-Bande auf einer Ranch, um auf die Beute zu warten, die Hogans Freundin Daisy vorbeibringen soll. Plötzlich taucht auch noch ein mysteriöser Fremder namens John Webb auf, der ebenfalls einen Anteil haben möchte. Es kommt zu einer großen Auseinandersetzung bei der es fast keine Überlebenden gibt.

programme.title: Copper Face
programme.desc: Die Revolverhelden Johnny West und Goofo retten zwei mexikanische Pferdediebe vor dem Tod durch den Strang. Zum Dank beteiligen die beiden Mexikaner Johnny und Goofo an der Jagd nach vier Goldkisten, die die Bande von Carranza geraubt und versteckt hat. Der kleinen Truppe schließen sich noch der Indianer Copperface und seine geldgierige Ex-Frau Maria an. Die Suche gestaltet sich erfolgreich, sie können Carranzas Männern das Gold wieder abjagen. Der Bandenchef kennt in seiner Gier nach dem Gold jedoch keine Gnade und einer nach dem anderen stirbt im Kugelhagel ...

programme.title: Die Krieger der Cheyenne
programme.desc: Als der Krieg sich zwischen der Union und der Konföderation dem Ende entgegen neigt, reisen Matthew und Rebecca Westen nach Oregon, um ein neues Leben zu beginnen. Auf dem Weg stoppen sie an einem entfernten Handelsposten, wo sie auf einige Cheyenne –Indianer treffen. Obwohl die Cheyenne freundlich zu den Pionieren sind, mag Matthäus sie nicht und warnt stattdessen eine Gruppe von Jägern, dass Indianer einen Überfall begehen wollen. In der Konfrontation und der Schiesserei, die sich daraus ergibt, überleben nur die schwangere Rebecca und einer der Cheyenne, namens Hawk . Als der Winter einbricht, sind die beiden aufeinander angewiesen und sie beginnen füreinander Gefühle und Vertrauen zu entwickeln.

programme.title: Cuchillo - Todeslied der Apachen
programme.desc: Ein roter Krieger nimmt Rache: In die Zeit des Letzten verzweifelten Aufbäumens der Indianer gegen ihre Ausrottung und Unterdrückung führt der Film 'Cuchillo - Todeslied der Apachen'. Er schildert den Rachefeldzug eines einzelnen Mannes, des Apachenkriegers Cuchillo (Andrés García), gegen einen brutalen General der US-Kavallerie. Allein auf sich gestellt, ohne fremde Hilfe erwarten zu können, nimmt Cuchillo den Kampf gegen die Übermacht auf. In todesmutigen Überfällen dezimiert er die Truppen des Generals Boyd, raubt die Nahrungsmittel, die er dann seinem hungernden Volk zukommen lässt. In furiosen Actionszenen zeigt der Film die gnadenlosen Auseinandersetzungen, in deren Verlauf Cuchillo schliesslich durch Verrat und Intrigen doch noch in eine Falle gelockt wird. Er kann sich mit Hilfe einiger Freunde aus dem Fort befreien. In der Bergwüste Arizonas kommt es dann zum letzten entscheidenden Kampf zwischen ihm und dem General.

programme.title: Der weite Weg nach Westen
programme.desc: Eine Siedlerfamilie Sergeant macht sich im Jahr 1867 auf den Weg nach Westen, um dort eine Farm zu betreiben. Nach dem Tod ihres Ehemannes John Sergeant muss sich Mutter Maggie Sergeant entscheiden, ob sie mit ihren Kindern an die Ostküste zurückkehren oder es auf sich allein gestellt versuchen soll. Was für ein langer und qualvoller Weg mit Entbehrungen vor ihnen liegt kann sie zu diesem Zeitpunkt noch nicht ahnen.

programme.title: Der Kampf der Brüder
programme.desc: Eine Familie ungarischer Einwanderer will sich in Swanson City, einer kleinen Stadt unweit von Dodge City, in den Weiten der USA niederlassen. Sie kaufen für etwas Geld ein Stück fast unfruchtbares Land; doch auch als sie merken, dass man sie betrogen hat, versuchen sie, das Beste aus ihrer Lage zu machen. Plötzlich jedoch versucht Mc Callum, der 'King' von Swanson, das Land aufzukaufen und die Leute zu verjagen. Doch diese kämpfen für ihr Land. Eines Tages, beim Graben eines Brunnens, verstehen alle Mc Callums Motivation: Öl!

programme.title: Shootout in the West
programme.desc: In einem vergleichsweise friedlichen Westernstädtchen nahe des Indianerreservats lebt der Farmer Doc mit seiner indianischen Frau Pearl und dem kleinen Sohn Jeremiah. Da taucht eines Tages Docs lang vermisster Vater, der Revolverheld John, in dem Nest auf und möchte in Ruhe bei seiner Familie leben. Nach anfänglichem MIsstrauen bricht das Eis, und der kleine Jeremiah gewinnt einen liebenden Großvater. Bis John die Vergangenheit einholt und ein Mann auftaucht, der ihn mit Nachdruck zu einem entgültigem Duell herausfordert.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: He’s a tough-guy afraid of loosing his freedom. She’s been through two ugly divorces. So when the “M” word comes up, they head for the hills. Join these commitment-challenged singles as Dr. Phil uncovers the reasons why they won’t take the plunge. You’ll also meet a man who, after a four years in a loving relationship, doesn’t see the need to get married. To him it’s just a piece of paper. To her it’s a lot more. Find out if it’s really a “deal breaker.”

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.sub-title: I Was Acquitted, My Ex Says Guilty
programme.desc: A woman confronts accusations of her involvement in her son's accidental overdose.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: YouTube sensation “Homeless Joe,” 26, survives on the mean streets of Manhattan by panhandling during the day and picking up women at night. Joe admits he could get a place of his own if he stopped drinking but says being homeless without alcohol is unbearable. Is this “cardboard Casanova” interested in turning his life around?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Out Of The Cult Follow Up
programme.desc: Dr. Phil follows up with a family whose story captivated viewers. Fourteen siblings say they suffered horrific beatings and molestation at the hands of their own father, who claimed to be the Messiah. The oldest daughter, Jeanne, says she was not only abused by her dad, but was forced to brutally beat her younger brothers and sisters to please their controlling patriarch. After the show, the relatives say they made great strides toward reconciliation, but tension and resentment still exist. Miriam and Sarah say Jeanne doesn’t physically abuse them anymore, but they still feel hurt by her constant judgments. They say she always preaches to them and criticizes them for drinking alcohol and for taking jobs as exotic dancers. Another sibling, Jewel, who recently reconnected with the family after 13 years, says Jeanne is jealous of her new bond with the family. Can the women heal the wounds of the past and move on with their lives?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil talks with couples who have the same fights over and over again. One couple fights every time they get in the car. She blames his reckless driving. He says she’s an annoying backseat driver. Find out what happens when she gets behind the wheel! Then, meet a husband who is fed up with his wife for returning everything—from their mattress to his favorite watch…to her engagement ring! Is she a scam artist or is her behavior a reflection of her past? Plus, Dr. Phil addresses his number one concern regarding parents who fight.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you or someone you know is pregnant, then you won’t want to miss today’s show! This episode is the first in a new series on pregnancy. Dr. Phil shares what they don’t tell you to expect when you’re expecting. Parents-to-be, Morgan and Shannon both have Type A personalities. She’s obsessed about her weight. He’s a neat freak. How can they prepare for an unpredictable lifestyle as parents? Then, tag along as they visit a daddy boot camp and a pregnancy gym. Plus, does carrying low mean you’re having a boy? An expert will help you sort out the truth from the myths when it comes to pregnancy.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is there such a thing as a forgivable lie? Today Dr. Phil talks to couples about working through the damage lies can cause in relationships. One woman says her husband lies so much that she’s ready for divorce. Also, this mom’s been divorced for two years and still hasn’t told her children. Is she living a lie? Plus, Dr. Phil tells you how to spot when your partner is deceiving you.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Meleah and Greg's young love story started and ended like so many. But when Meleah discovered she was pregnant following their breakup, their lives became forever intertwined. Watch as sparks fly when they face off! Plus, Paige was a teen mom struggling to make ends meet. You won't want to miss her remarkable update!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Should transgender athletes be allowed to compete with those of the gender they identify with or must they only compete with athletes who share the gender they were assigned at birth? Are laws that ban transgender women from participating in women's sports fair? LGBTQ+ activists have described criteria limiting transgender athlete involvement in gendered sports as "discriminatory.” Lia Thomas made headline news and stirred debate when she competed in swimming nationals as a transgender woman. Dr. Phil, along with Layne Ingram, a transgender man and basketball coach, and Olympic swimmer Nancy Hogshead-Makar, an advocate for girls and women in sports and CEO of Champion Women, discuss what they believe is right and fair. Then, Riley Gaines, who competed against Lia Thomas, gives her perspective on how she felt after their race. The big question is: what does the science say? Harvard professor Dr. Carole Hooven breaks it down.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tracy is a successful, working actress who has appeared on many daytime soap operas including The Bold and The Beautiful and The Young and The Restless. She wrote into the show urgently seeking Dr. Phil’s help for her real-life drama of her hoarding 71-year-old-mother, Robin, who could be evicted from her home at any minute. Tracy claims her mother’s homes have always been filled with filth, chaos, and animals, and she’s never taken responsibility for the conditions Tracy lived in growing up. Tracy says she feels like the child of a drug addict, except the drug is hoarding, and she’s looking for Dr. Phil’s help to truly change her mom’s behavior before she’s back in another house of filth again. Robin says she knows she needs help with her hoarding, but the idea of getting rid of her possessions gives her anxiety. She says she’s ready to fix herself with the help of Dr. Phil, and this show is an answer to her prayers.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Many little girls dream of the perfect wedding day with a fairytale gown, beautiful flowers and their handsome groom, but Dr. Phil's guests say their wedding bells hit a sour note. Amy says the day she and Steve tied the knot turned into a disaster. The sun scorched the guests, then there was a downpour, the wedding arch fell and hit the pastor, and the cake crumbled as they were cutting it. She says it was a huge dream shattered, and she can't move past it. Steve says he had a blast, and Amy needs to lighten up. What does Dr. Phil think? Then, shortly after Mandy and her husband, Kris, said "I do," a three-story deck collapsed and they and 30 of their family and friends were seriously injured. Mandy says she left her wedding strapped to a stretcher, and she and Kris spent their wedding night in the emergency room. Although this took place over two years ago, the couple thinks about it every day. How can they overcome their guilt? And, Kurt and Brandi recently renewed their vows because they say they wanted a fresh start to their seven-year marriage. Just months after their ceremony, Kurt filed for divorce when he found out a secret Brandi had been keeping. Will the results of polygraph tests inspire this couple to make their marriage work or end it for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Does your child lie, steal, swear, or test you daily? Karen and Matt's son is only 4 years old, but he’s already cursing! Patty and Eric's 8-year-old son has been stealing since kindergarten. Now, they’re worried this could lead to a life of crime. Plus, a boy whose nickname is Dracula because he’s always biting somebody! And, what if you kept finding your 4-year-old in his birthday suit with the little girl next door? Beverly and Shea say they can't figure out why their kids like to get naked and play.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: These moms are sick and tired of living a lie. One mom fears her secret addiction to pain killers will tear her family apart. She asks Dr. Phil to help her get off the drugs before she loses everything, including her unborn child! Also, a grandmother who steals everything from steaks to ceiling fans. She says she knows it’s wrong and wants to stop, but is she really just afraid of getting caught? Plus, a mother confesses to her daughter a secret she has been carrying for 29 years.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Did you know that close to 14 million adults still live at home with their parents? Dr. Phil’s first guest is 30 years old, has 2 kids, and is still living with her mom! Her mom wants her out, so why won’t she leave? Then, meet one mother who made her son sign a contract to move out for good. The deadline has lapsed, but he won’t budge. How far will Dr. Phil go to push him out of the nest? Plus, meet a couple who opened their home to 21 family members over the last 7 years. Finally, their nephew came to stay for a couple of days…and two years later he’s still there!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is lack of confidence holding you back in your life? Then join today’s guests and enroll in Dr. Phil’s confidence course. Meet one woman who has zero confidence in social situations and says she wishes she were more beautiful, like her identical twin sister! You’ll also meet an artist who used to weigh 500 pounds. He’s shed the weight, but hasn’t shed his fear of talking to women. Plus, will a classically trained pianist overcome her fear of performing in front of crowds? Find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's do or die for the men today, as their partners tell them to either walk down the aisle or walk the highway! Plus, Robin has tips for maintaining a healthy relationship.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tiffany and Mindy describe their mother, Phyllis, as “the most selfish person on the face of the earth.” They say their entire childhoods were affected by her self-absorbed behavior, ultimately fracturing their relationship. Tiffany says she worries she won’t even be able to come up with anything nice to say about her mother at her funeral. Phyllis insists she was a great mother, and her daughters have it all wrong. Dr. Phil goes over some of the incidents her daughters report as manipulative and self-centered. Will Phyllis own up to her parenting mistakes and apologize? And, Chanell says her friend, Shauna, suffers from “Pretty Girl Selfish Syndrome” and needs an intervention. Shauna says she’s open to a minor tweak in her behavior, but a major overhaul is out of the question. And, see the remarkable progress of two women who Dr. Phil says should be selfish and put themselves first: Amanda and Bekki from the 17 Day Diet Challenge. Plus, Dr. Phil celebrates his 1500th show with his oldest and youngest fans!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When it comes to families, conflict is nearly inevitable, but when you add the stress of a mental illness, it can divide even the closest knit household. Coni’s 18-year-old daughter, Katherine, was diagnosed with bipolar disorder at 12. Since then, her daughter’s behavior has been violent and erratic, and Coni says the chaos is tearing their family apart. Coni’s husband has threatened divorce, her oldest son has moved out, and her youngest daughter says her childhood was awful because of her older sister. The family thinks Katherine should be moved to a facility that can better serve her, but Coni says that is not an option. Learn what Dr. Phil says this family is doing wrong and how they can create a happy, peaceful household.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When you enter into a new relationship, putting your best foot forward and making a solid commitment is important. But how do you do that if you've been burned in the past or are still in love with an ex?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Have you ever thought about how your relationship with your dad affects your life? A daughter who has a positive relationship with her father often has a better chance of thriving in life. But for girls who realize they're not Daddy's little girl, the damage to their life can be devastating. Lauren says her dad has not been there for her emotionally and financially, and she blames him for everything that has gone wrong in her life. They fight often, and she says she wants to let go of him and move on, but her father, Gary, wants her back in his life. Lauren has a college degree but is working in a scandalous profession. Is her job choice related to her relationship with her father? When father and daughter reveal important information they've each been hiding, how will they react to each other’s revelations? What do Lauren and Gary need to do to move forward with their lives, and will it include having a relationship with each other? Then, Angela and her daughter, Lily, are both experiencing the aftermath of not having a relationship with their fathers. Angela says she's had problems with men her entire life and worries Lily will also. Lily says her father is not there for her, and she has given up hope that they can revive their relationship. Are Angela's actions causing a rift between Lily and her father? Dr. Phil has a stern warning for the teen.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: More than 170,000 U.S. troops are stationed in Iraq and Afghanistan, sacrificing life and limb to keep America safe. Nearly 40,000 have been wounded, an estimated 300,000 are living with Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), and in 2005, there were at least 6,256 suicides among those serving in the armed forces. Many vets say when they return home, they feel mistreated and neglected and are forced to fight a medical system bureaucracy that doesn't hear them. Are we doing enough to care for our heroes? Find out what's really going on as Dr. Phil tackles this hot-button issue!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Get My Groom to Grow Up
programme.desc: Do you have a man in your life who stomps his feet, pouts, whines and acts like a toddler? A bride-to-be is dealing with an immature fiance and a meddling mother-in-law, and a mooching groom is living in his mom's basement with his common-law wife and baby. Today's guests are grown men whose loved ones want them to grow up!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A Mother-in -Law accuses her Daugher-in-Law of political corruption, and even murder. Can these two call a truce with the help of Dr Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On today’s show, Dr. Phil looks at the roles of married couples. You may think her job looks easy, and she may think you don’t do a thing all day! Dr. Phil puts his own marriage to the test by switching daily routines with his wife, Robin. Can they handle the daily grind of each other’s lives? It’s not as easy as it looks to walk in your spouse’s shoes. You may even walk away from today’s episode with a little better perspective.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Scared Of My Own Father Part 1
programme.desc: Pat and his wife, Sarah, claim they’re scared for their family’s safety. Pat claims his father, John, is delusional, violent, paranoid and so dangerous, that Pat sleeps on the couch in his living room to protect his wife and two children in the event that John comes to the house at night to harm them. Pat and Sarah say John’s delusions have gotten so bad they’ve had to cut ties with him. John, on the other hand, completely denies the allegations. He says his daughter-in-law is to blame for stealing his son, filling his head with evil and turning Pat against him. Can Dr. Phil bridge the gap between father and son and bring this whole family back together again?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Morgan and Ashley claim their mom, Treva, is “a toxic, violent alcoholic,” who they say is way out of control, and that although she’s been to rehab eight times, she’s never stayed sober. In the past year, Morgan says the police have been called to the house 57 times for violence, threats, assault and even arson. Morgan says if her mom doesn’t stop her excessive drinking and end the violence, she will walk away for good. Treva says she does not want to go to another “dumb treatment center” as she is “done with them” and claims they do not work for her. Treva has said that she believes the problem is 10% her and 90% everyone else – and that she believes her family needs an intervention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Some teachers today are turning schoolboy fantasies into sexual realities with their inappropriate conduct towards underage students. Mary Kay Letourneau, who admitted to authorities that she had sex with a 13-year-old former student; Debra Lafave, accused of having sex with a 14-year-old student, and Pamela Rogers, accused of sending sexually-explicit videos to a 14-year-old boy, are just a few examples.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine your weight getting so out of control that it confined you to your home, to a room, even to a bed. Dr. Phil's guests say they feel trapped and isolated in their homes and miss their loved ones.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you spend money frivolously, or do you hold on to every cent? Katie says when she and her husband, Joe, were dating, he wined and dined her, but when they got married, he became so cheap that she had to buy her own wedding ring, and he refused to take her on a honeymoon. When Katie lost over 40 pounds and wanted to buy clothes that fit, she says Joe told her to just gain the weight back. Joe says he has to control all of Katie's spending, or they would end up in the poorhouse. Is Joe really the penny-pincher Katie says he is, or is Katie's spending the real problem? Next, Ericka says her friend, Carlena, has "caviar taste with a tuna fish budget," and that if she doesn't learn to control her shopaholic ways, she'll end up on the street. Carlena says she deserves everything she buys -- designer clothes, over 100 pairs of shoes, and the TV in her car -- even if she can't afford them. Carlena's spending has gotten so bad, she had to move back home with her mother, Leonetta. Leonetta joins the show via satellite with all of Carlena's possessions on her lawn. Don’t miss her shocking ultimatum to her daughter!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After 12 years of marriage, Ed revealed to Kandi that he'd been having an affair and his mistress is now pregnant. Dr. Phil continues his in-depth look at the anatomy of an affair.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Paul was his family’s rock and role model, so when he suddenly passed away, his wife and four children say their lives were shattered. Debbie, who was married to Paul for 30 years, says she shut down after his death and doesn’t know how to unite her brood. Sisters Jamie, Erica and Tayler say they don’t know how to properly grieve, they’re always fighting with each other, and they’re upset that their brother, Paul, turned his back on them. Paul says he didn’t run away from his loved ones; he has his own family and says he feels stretched thin. Find out the secret Erica’s been keeping that threatens to throw everyone into further turmoil, and hear the final wish Jamie’s dad had for her. If you’re grappling with grief after the loss of a relative, learn how to find closure and peace.
